about.title: About Sahakar Sathi
about.lead: A multilingual assistant and information service for cooperative members, farmers and rural citizens in India.
about.what: It answers questions about cooperative governance and law, Ministry of Cooperation schemes, PACS services, PMFBY crop insurance, financial literacy and grievance redressal — in English, Hindi and Tamil, by text or voice. It also lets you file and track a grievance.
about.who: Cooperative members, farmers and rural citizens who want reliable guidance without a language barrier. It is designed for use on a basic mobile phone and for people with limited reading ability.
about.sources1: Information comes from official government and cooperative documents. Every answer marks what is stated in an official source and what is a plain-language explanation, and links to the source where one is available.
about.sources2: The assistant does not invent schemes, laws, eligibility rules, deadlines, amounts or contact details. When it has no verified information, it says so and points you to the appropriate office.
about.limits: This is a prototype built for the Smart India Hackathon. It is not an official government service, it does not have real-time access to government systems, and the explanatory content is currently available in English only.
